## Source: kam193 (4c0bf9342dc65fdfebad3bb1984e9140f3132df7268d0d401ad3fb745aef8c95)
This package fingerprints the current environment and can collect full environment variables of the current and all other processes. While this has to be explicitly requested, a sibling package from the same uploader was hiding silent exfiltration of these sensitive data. As such, this package should be considered preparation for malicious activity.


---
